scope.description:
Oversampling scope: ADC groups regular and/or injected.
If ADC group injected conversion insertion within regular sequence:
- setting continued: when group injected is triggered, the oversampling on group regular is temporary stopped and continued afterwards.
- setting resumed: when group injected is triggered, the oversampling on group regular is resumed from start (oversampler buffer reset). This device supports parallel injected oversampling, allowing to perform oversampling on groups regular and injected independently (different accumulators with their own settings ratio and shift), refer to panel 'Oversampling group injected'.

oneOf.title: Regular (continued)
oneOf.description: ADC oversampling on conversions of ADC group regular. If ADC group injected conversion insertion within regular sequence: oversampling on group regular is temporary stopped and, after injected conversion, continued (oversampling accumulator maintained).

oneOf.title: Regular (resumed)
oneOf.description: ADC oversampling on conversions of ADC group regular. If ADC group injected conversion insertion within regular sequence: after injected conversion, oversampling on group regular is resumed from start (oversampler accumulator reset).

oneOf.title: Injected
oneOf.description: ADC oversampling on conversions of ADC group injected, in sequential mode: oversampling conversions sequence sequential, switching data registers after each oversampling process (all ratio occurrences, shift).

oneOf.title: Regular and injected
oneOf.description: ADC oversampling on conversions of ADC groups regular and injected. Combination of modes 'Regular (resumed)' and 'Injected': refer to description of these parameters.
